questions.question: What structures are found inside the cells of plant leaves where photosynthesis occurs?
options: Mitochondria only
Chloroplasts
Ribosomes only
Stomata

questions.question: In which part of a plant cell does photosynthesis take place?
options: Nucleus
Vacuole
Chloroplast
Cell wall

questions.question: What green chemical substance is contained in chloroplasts to absorb light?
options: Chlorophyll
Cellulose
Cytoplasm
Carbohydrate

questions.question: Why are plant leaves typically very thin?
options: To help them float on water
To allow light to pass through to cells containing chloroplasts
To prevent them from becoming too heavy for the stem
To let water escape quickly from the plant

questions.question: How does having a large surface area benefit a plant's leaves?
options: It helps the leaf absorb light for photosynthesis
It makes it easier for roots to anchor the plant
It protects the leaf from being eaten by insects
It reduces the amount of water the plant needs

questions.question: Which gas do plant leaves take in from the air for photosynthesis?
options: Oxygen
Carbon dioxide
Nitrogen
Hydrogen

questions.question: What happens to the oxygen produced by plants during photosynthesis?
options: It is stored inside the roots as a food source
It is released as a gas from leaves into the air
It is instantly converted into water inside the stem
It is dissolved into the soil through the roots

questions.question: What is the process called where leaves take in carbon dioxide and release oxygen?
options: Transpiration
Respiration
Gas exchange
Fermentation

questions.question: What are the small holes on the surface of a leaf called that are used for gas exchange?
options: Pores
Chloroplasts
Stomata
Veins

questions.question: By what process do gas molecules move through open stomata?
options: Osmosis
Diffusion
Active transport
Evaporation

questions.question: What term is used to describe organisms like plants that can make their own food?
options: Consumers
Decomposers
Producers
Predators

questions.question: Under what condition can the process of photosynthesis take place?
options: Only when it is dark
Only when there is light
Only when the temperature is below freezing
Only during the night

questions.question: Which of the following describes the nature of photosynthesis inside cells?
options: A single physical change
A series of chemical reactions
A mechanical filtration process
A state of physical dormancy

questions.question: What are the correct reactants and products of photosynthesis?
options: Reactants: oxygen and glucose; Products: water and carbon dioxide
Reactants: water and carbon dioxide; Products: oxygen and glucose
Reactants: nitrogen and water; Products: oxygen and carbon dioxide
Reactants: oxygen and water; Products: glucose and nitrogen

questions.question: Why is a word summary of reactants and products used to describe photosynthesis?
options: It is a physical scale model of the leaf structure
It is a model of the process because it involves many chemical reactions
It shows the exact speed at which photosynthesis happens
It lists all the different minerals a plant takes from soil

questions.question: Which set of resources must plants have to stay alive and grow?
options: Light, air, water and minerals
Soil, insects, warmth and oxygen only
Carbohydrates, proteins, fats and vitamins from soil
Darkness, dry soil, sugar and carbon dioxide

questions.question: How do plants obtain different necessary resources from their environment?
options: They take in water and minerals through leaves, and light and gases through roots
They take in water and minerals through roots, and light and gases through leaves
They take in all resources through roots only
They take in all resources through leaves only

questions.question: What is the role of water and minerals in plant nutrition?
options: They are the food that plants eat
They are not food, but plants need them to stay alive and grow
They are the products of photosynthesis
They are stored in leaves as carbohydrates

questions.question: Which of the following is true about how plants obtain food?
options: They absorb it directly from the surrounding soil
They take it in from other nearby plants
They do not take in food from their surroundings; they make their own
They ingest tiny insects through their leaves

questions.question: What food do plants make, and what do they use it for?
options: Protein, which they use to repair damaged roots
Fats, which they use to protect themselves from cold
Carbohydrate, which they use for growth and as a source of energy
Minerals, which they use to color their flowers
